name: Otomaid @ Cafe
source: Kei agrees to take a part-time job at his brother Iori's cafe. Then he learns that it's a maid cafe run by crossdressers, and his cute coworkers are actually boys. He doesn't understand why men would want to wear women's clothing, but he's about to learn.
translation: 圭同意在他哥哥伊织的咖啡馆做一份兼职工作。然后他得知这是一家由变装者经营的女仆咖啡馆，而他可爱的同事实际上是男孩。他不明白为什么男人想穿女装，但他即将学习。
